# Jesus, Friend of Sinners (Luke 7:34)

## Emotional Focus
Knowing Jesus is the truest friend who forgives and loves.

## Key KJV
“The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!” (Luke 7:34)

## Gentle Retelling
Some people called Jesus a friend of sinners because He ate with people who had made mistakes. Jesus showed them love and forgiveness.

## Coloring Prompt
Jesus sitting at a table smiling with people who look surprised and happy.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Jesus is your forever friend who forgives and loves you.”
